summary: When $azoth-dynamic-full-auto is invoked in Codex the network-disabled limitation (Wave A researcher tasks cannot fetch external URLs because network_access = false) is documented only in the Happy path — Codex section of the deep-linked SKILL.md. A user invoking the skill in Codex has no upfront warning at the wrapper level. This creates a discoverability gap: the pipeline will start, discovery waves will be dispatched, and only then will the operator realize Wave A research against external sources is unavailable.
evidence: .agents/skills/azoth-dynamic-full-auto/SKILL.md simply redirects to .claude/commands/dynamic-full-auto.md which redirects to .agents/skills/dynamic-full-auto/SKILL.md. The network_access = false warning is only in SKILL.md under Happy path — Codex (line ~278). .codex/config.toml confirms network_access = false.
recommended_action: Add a short Codex notice near the top of .agents/skills/azoth-dynamic-full-auto/SKILL.md or in the Execution contract block noting that Wave A external research is unavailable in Codex (network disabled) and operators should use pre-seeded context or delegate to a network-enabled platform for that phase.

summary: Auto-router Rule 10 (complexity == medium AND risk == additive, non-known-pattern) selects stage_families [architect-design, plan, execute, quality-gate, closeout] without context-recall. Rules 4 and 5 (instruction-refinement) both mandate context-recall for L2 evidence loading even at the same complexity level. Rule 10 targets novel medium-additive work where unknown memory or recent episode state could influence the architectural decision. Omitting context-recall from this lane is internally consistent if the architect is expected to manually load context, but the SKILL.md rationale does not explain this choice, leaving a potential silent gap for memory-dependent novel work.
evidence: auto-router SKILL.md Rule 10 rationale: 'Medium-complexity additive work where the knowledge dimension is not known-pattern'. Stage families listed: architect-design, plan, execute, quality-gate, closeout — no context-recall. Compare Rules 4/5 which include context-recall. auto.pipeline.yaml Rule 10 stage_families list confirms.
recommended_action: Either add context-recall to Rule 10 stage families (aligning with instruction-refinement lane precedent) or add an explicit rationale note in SKILL.md Rule 10 explaining why context-recall is intentionally omitted for novel medium-additive work (e.g., architect is responsible for loading context inline).
